referral.title: Referrals
referral.headline: Bring people in. Get paid for years.
referral.subhead: Share your {{site}} link. When someone joins through it and becomes a paying customer, they're your referral — and you earn a percentage of everything they actually pay, for up to three years.
referral.inactiveNote: Your referral link is ready. Referrals switch on when you subscribe — or right away when you start through the card door.
referral.qualifyBody: Your first three paying referrals don't earn cash yet — but your third earns you a free month. The moment your fourth paying referral pays, you qualify, and from that day forward you earn on all of them. Commissions start on your qualification day; payments made before that day don't earn commission — nothing is paid retroactively. Your first four referrals' clocks all start on your qualification day; every later referral's clock starts on their first payment. Your qualification month counts in full.
referral.notQualifiedYet: Not qualified yet — {{count}} of {{goal}} paying referrals.
referral.whatYouEarn: What you earn on each referral
referral.fourthYearBody: only for referrals you bring in while you have {{threshold}} or more active paying referrals. Those referrals keep their fourth year permanently, even if your count later drops; if your count dips below the threshold, you have {{grace}} months to climb back before new referrals stop earning it.
referral.onlyCollected: You earn only on money actually collected — never on invoices or promises. If a payment is refunded or charged back, the commission on it is adjusted or reversed; if it was already paid out to you, it comes back as a negative adjustment on your next payout. Your commission on a referral lasts only while that referral is a paying customer: if they cancel, it stops; if they come back while their clock is still running, it picks up again where their clock has reached — the clock never restarts.
referral.friendBenefitBody: Someone who joins through your link gets two weeks with the tier above their plan turned on — a real taste of the tier above. If they sign up at the top tier (Heavy), there's no tier above, so they get their first two months half off instead.
referral.youGotTierUp: You joined through a referral link: your {{tier}} tier is on for {{days}} days from your plan start.
referral.youGotHalfOff: You joined through a referral link at the top tier: your first {{months}} paid months are half off.
referral.friendHalfOff: Friend benefit: first {{months}} months half off
referral.whenPaid: When and how you get paid
referral.clearing: Earnings become payable {{days}} days after they're earned, and payouts are made monthly.
referral.railStripe: sent to your connected Stripe account in the monthly batch.
referral.railCheckBody: a $2 fee is deducted from the payout. You'll always see the fee before you choose this option.
referral.fairPlayBody: Referring yourself doesn't count, and one payment never earns twice. Confirmed abuse — including duplicate accounts made to game the program — removes you from the referral program: three months for a first strike, permanently for a second. That's the referral program only — never your {{site}} account.
